rows.name: Build chassis and test one motor
rows.done: Chassis assembled; motor commands stay within limits; disabling control or losing commands stops the motor.

rows.name: Connect all motors, steering and wheel sensors
rows.done: Steering calibrated; sensor readings recorded together; no unexplained controller resets.

rows.name: Hold a heading and stop on radio loss
rows.done: Record a 20-minute drive; losing the radio stops motion; restarting requires a deliberate command.

rows.name: Check: rover is safe to drive
rows.done: The rover drives safely by remote control and can hold a steady heading.

rows.name: Connect rover sensors to the computer
rows.done: The computer receives wheel and motion-sensor readings with matching times and a consistent model of the rover.

rows.name: Estimate position and practice virtual navigation
rows.done: Combine sensor readings into a position estimate, inspect its errors and repeat navigation routes in simulation.

rows.name: Practice one drone mission in simulation
rows.done: A virtual drone takes off, flies a square and handles an intentionally lost connection; write the real-flight test procedure.

rows.name: Check: ready for indoor flight
rows.done: The simulation passes, an appropriate indoor flight area is ready and the purchase fits the budget.

rows.name: Buy the first small indoor drone
rows.done: Buy one Crazyflie indoor drone bundle after the readiness check; recheck the historical price estimate.

rows.name: Repeat a real takeoff, route and landing
rows.done: Complete ten takeoff, route and landing missions without pilot correction.

rows.name: Add a laser scanner for mapping
rows.done: Confirm the laser scanner works with the robotics software and check price and return policy before buying.

rows.name: Build a map and navigate with the rover
rows.done: Save and reload a map, find the rover’s position on it and complete three runs without contact; record failures.

rows.name: Decide: does the rover need its own computer?
rows.done: Only add an onboard computer if the cable limits testing; account for power and storage, and verify the rover stops if the computer fails.

rows.name: Rehearse several drones moving together
rows.done: Virtual drones follow checked routes with adequate separation and synchronized starts; test stopping one aircraft and the whole group.

rows.name: Check: ready to consider a second drone
rows.done: Before adding another drone, repeat single-drone missions and demonstrate how aircraft share position coordinates and handle failures independently.
